record.title: Elevated Request Errors for Grafana Across Multiple Regions
components: Federal Cloud - AWS US Gov West

updates.body: We are investigating some failed requests affecting Grafana across multiple Grafana Cloud regions, beginning at approximately 12:10 UTC. Customers may see slow-loading or failing dashboards and Explore queries, and some requests may time out or be cancelled. Our engineers are actively investigating. Next update by 13:30 UTC.

We have identified the cause of the elevated request errors affecting Grafana across multiple Grafana Cloud regions and are applying mitigation. Customers may still see slow-loading or failing dashboards and Explore queries while recovery continues. Next update by 13:30 UTC.

We have identified the cause of the elevated request errors affecting Grafana across multiple Grafana Cloud regions and have applied a mitigation. We are seeing early signs of recovery and are monitoring closely. Customers may still see slow-loading or failing dashboards and Explore queries while recovery continues. Next update by 13:30 UTC.

We have identified the cause of the elevated request errors affecting Grafana across multiple Grafana Cloud regions and have applied a mitigation. We are seeing signs of recovery and are continuing to monitor closely. Customers may still see slow-loading or failing dashboards and Explore queries while recovery continues. Next update by 14:00 UTC.

Between approximately 12:10 UTC and 13:22 UTC on 3 November (about 1 hour 12 minutes), Grafana across multiple Grafana Cloud regions experienced elevated request errors, causing slow-loading or failing dashboards and Explore queries. The issue has been resolved and service has been fully restored.
